actions.createPost.description: Adds a post to the collection linked to your Nuelink automation token. Needs an Automation Token connection; with an API key, use Create Post in Collection.
actions.createPost.props.altText.descrip: Enter an alt text for your image or video.
actions.createPost.props.media.descripti: Public URL of one image or video. Nuelink downloads it, so it must open without a login.
actions.createPost.props.postAsShort.des: We will treat the videos imported as short-form vertical videos (Reels, Shorts, Tiktoks etc...).
actions.createPost.props.postAsShort.dis: Treat videos as short-form vertical videos
actions.createPost.props.shareToFeed.des: Share your Instagram Reel to your feed as well.
actions.createPost.props.title.descripti: Enter a title to use for your Reels, videos and/or Pinterest posts.
actions.create_collection_post.descripti: Creates a post in a Nuelink collection as a draft, in the queue, at a scheduled time or right away. It goes to every channel in the collection.
actions.create_collection_post.props.alt: Describes the image or video for screen readers (up to 255 characters).
actions.create_collection_post.props.aut: Let Nuelink split text that is too long for a channel into a thread.
Split Long Text into a Thread
actions.create_collection_post.props.cap: The text of the post, up to 3,000 characters. Separating parts with two empty lines turns it into a thread (up to 10 parts).
actions.create_collection_post.props.col: The collection to add the post to. The post is published to every channel connected to it.
actions.create_collection_post.props.fir: A comment Nuelink adds under the post after it is published (up to 1,000 characters). Set First Comment Delay too.
How many seconds after publishing to post the first comment. Required when First Comment is set.
actions.create_collection_post.props.ins: Instagram username to invite as a collaborator.
When on, Instagram Reels also appear in the feed. When off, Nuelink's default applies.
actions.create_collection_post.props.lin: Destination link for Pinterest pins and the Google Business "Learn more" button.
actions.create_collection_post.props.med: Up to 10 images or videos. Each entry is a public http(s) URL that Nuelink downloads (it must open without a login), or a media ID from Upload Media.
actions.create_collection_post.props.pos: Publish as a story on channels that support stories.
actions.create_collection_post.props.pub: Draft saves the post without publishing it. Queue gives it the collection's next free time slot. Schedule publishes it at Scheduled Time. Publish Now sends it to every channel immediately.
actions.create_collection_post.props.sch: Only for Publish Mode = Schedule, at least 10 minutes ahead. Include a timezone offset; it is converted to the brand's timezone for Nuelink.
actions.create_collection_post.props.tik: When on, TikTok adds music to photo posts. When off, Nuelink's default applies.
actions.create_collection_post.props.tit: Title used for videos, Reels and Pinterest pins (up to 255 characters).
actions.delete_post.description: Permanently deletes a post from Nuelink. Anything already published on a social network stays there. Needs "Allow AI to perform sensitive actions" turned on in Nuelink Settings → API.
actions.delete_post.props.postId.descrip: The numeric ID of the post to delete, from Create Post in Collection or List Posts.
actions.list_posts.description: Lists a brand's drafts, queued, scheduled and published posts, one page at a time.
actions.list_posts.props.collection.desc: Only list posts of this collection. Leave empty for all collections.
actions.list_posts.props.createdFrom.des: Only posts created at or after this time. A time without a timezone is read as UTC.
actions.list_posts.props.createdTo.descr: Only posts created at or before this time. A time without a timezone is read as UTC.
actions.list_posts.props.page.descriptio: Which page of results to return, starting at 1. When the output says hasMore is true, run again with the next page number.
actions.list_posts.props.perPage.descrip: How many results to return per page (1 to 100).
actions.list_posts.props.view.descriptio: Which kind of posts to list. Leave empty for all.
actions.list_published_posts.description: Lists what Nuelink sent to each channel, with the delivery status, the link to the post and its engagement counts.
actions.list_published_posts.props.chann: Only return results for this social channel.
actions.list_published_posts.props.colle: Only results from this collection. Leave empty for all collections.
Which page of results to return, starting at 1. When the output says hasMore is true, run again with the next page number.
actions.list_published_posts.props.perPa: How many results to return per page (1 to 100).
actions.list_published_posts.props.postI: Only results of this Nuelink post (the ID from Create Post in Collection or List Posts).
actions.list_published_posts.props.publi: Only results published at or after this time. A time without a timezone is read as UTC.
Only results published at or before this time. A time without a timezone is read as UTC.
actions.list_published_posts.props.searc: Only results whose published text contains this (not case-sensitive, up to 255 characters).
actions.nuelink_add_collection_channel.d: Connects one of the brand's channels to a collection, so the collection's posts publish there too.
actions.nuelink_add_collection_channel.p: The numeric brand ID from nuelink_list_brands.
The numeric channel ID from nuelink_list_channels.
The numeric collection ID from nuelink_list_collections.
actions.nuelink_add_collection_queue_slo: Adds a weekly time slot (weekday and time, brand timezone) to a collection's queue.
The numeric brand ID from nuelink_list_brands.
The numeric collection ID from nuelink_list_collections.
actions.nuelink_create_automation.descri: Creates an RSS or feed automation that turns new feed items into posts in a collection.
Defaults to true. False lets imported posts publish through the queue.
The numeric brand ID from nuelink_list_brands.
The numeric collection ID (nuelink_list_collections) that receives the posts.
Public http(s) URL of the feed.
Defaults to false. True back-fills the whole feed; only allowed with drafts.
actions.nuelink_create_collection.descri: Creates a collection in a brand, optionally with channels and weekly queue time slots.
The numeric brand ID from nuelink_list_brands.
Numeric channel IDs from nuelink_list_channels. Posts in the collection publish to these.
Republish posts every N weeks; 0 or empty turns it off.
Weekly brand-local slots like "Mon 09:30". Duplicates are removed.
actions.nuelink_create_post.description: Creates a post (caption, poll or both) in a Nuelink collection as a draft, in the queue, scheduled or published now.
actions.nuelink_create_post.props.alt.de: Alt text for the media (up to 255 characters).
actions.nuelink_create_post.props.autoTh: Let Nuelink split long text into a thread.
Split Long Text into a Thread
actions.nuelink_create_post.props.brandI: The numeric brand ID from nuelink_list_brands.
actions.nuelink_create_post.props.captio: Post text, up to 3,000 characters. Optional when a poll is set.
actions.nuelink_create_post.props.collec: The numeric collection ID from nuelink_list_collections. The post goes to every channel in it.
actions.nuelink_create_post.props.firstC: Comment added after publishing (up to 1,000 characters). Needs First Comment Delay.
Seconds after publishing to add the first comment.
actions.nuelink_create_post.props.instag: Instagram username to invite as collaborator.
actions.nuelink_create_post.props.link.d: Destination link for Pinterest pins and the Google Business button.
Up to 10 entries: public http(s) URLs, or media IDs from nuelink_upload_file or nuelink_list_media.
actions.nuelink_create_post.props.pollCo: Zero-based index of the correct answer, for quiz polls.
actions.nuelink_create_post.props.pollEx: Shown with the correct answer (up to 512 characters).
actions.nuelink_create_post.props.pollOp: 2 to 4 answers, each up to 30 characters.
actions.nuelink_create_post.props.pollQu: Up to 280 characters. Setting any poll field requires Question, Options and Duration.
actions.nuelink_create_post.props.postAs: Publish as a story where supported.
actions.nuelink_create_post.props.publis: DRAFT (default) saves without publishing, QUEUE takes the next free slot, SCHEDULE publishes at Scheduled Time, IMMEDIATE publishes now.
actions.nuelink_create_post.props.schedu: Only with Publish Mode SCHEDULE. ISO-8601 with an offset or Z, e.g. 2026-10-12T09:00:00+03:00.
Title for videos, Reels and Pinterest pins (up to 255 characters).
actions.nuelink_delete_collection_queue_: Deletes one weekly time slot from a collection's queue.
The numeric brand ID from nuelink_list_brands.
The numeric collection ID the slot belongs to.
The numeric queue slot ID from nuelink_get_schedule or nuelink_list_collections.
actions.nuelink_delete_post.description: Permanently deletes a post from Nuelink, in any status. Content already on a social network stays there.
actions.nuelink_delete_post.props.brandI: The numeric brand ID from nuelink_list_brands.
actions.nuelink_delete_post.props.postId: The numeric post ID from nuelink_list_brand_posts.
actions.nuelink_get_me.description: Returns the Nuelink user the API key belongs to.
actions.nuelink_get_schedule.description: Returns every weekly queue time slot of a brand, grouped by weekday, in the brand timezone.
actions.nuelink_get_schedule.props.brand: The numeric brand ID from nuelink_list_brands.
actions.nuelink_list_automations.descrip: Lists a brand's RSS and feed automations.
actions.nuelink_list_automations.props.b: The numeric brand ID from nuelink_list_brands.
actions.nuelink_list_automations.props.p: Which page of results to return, starting at 1. When the output says hasMore is true, run again with the next page number.
How many results to return per page (1 to 100).
actions.nuelink_list_brand_posts.descrip: Lists a brand's posts (drafts, queued, scheduled, published), optionally for one collection, one page at a time.
actions.nuelink_list_brand_posts.props.b: The numeric brand ID from nuelink_list_brands.
actions.nuelink_list_brand_posts.props.c: Only posts of this collection (numeric ID from nuelink_list_collections). Empty for all.
ISO-8601 time; a value without offset is read as UTC.
ISO-8601 time; a value without offset is read as UTC.
actions.nuelink_list_brand_posts.props.p: Which page of results to return, starting at 1. When the output says hasMore is true, run again with the next page number.
How many results to return per page (1 to 100).
actions.nuelink_list_brands.description: Lists the Nuelink brands the API key can access, with their IDs and timezones.
actions.nuelink_list_brands.props.page.d: Which page of results to return, starting at 1. When the output says hasMore is true, run again with the next page number.
actions.nuelink_list_brands.props.perPag: How many results to return per page (1 to 100).
actions.nuelink_list_channels.descriptio: Lists the social channels connected to a brand.
actions.nuelink_list_channels.props.bran: The numeric brand ID from nuelink_list_brands.
actions.nuelink_list_channels.props.page: Which page of results to return, starting at 1. When the output says hasMore is true, run again with the next page number.
actions.nuelink_list_channels.props.perP: How many results to return per page (1 to 100).
actions.nuelink_list_collections.descrip: Lists a brand's collections with their channels, queue slots and post counts.
actions.nuelink_list_collections.props.b: The numeric brand ID from List Brands.
actions.nuelink_list_collections.props.p: Which page of results to return, starting at 1. When the output says hasMore is true, run again with the next page number.
How many results to return per page (1 to 100).
actions.nuelink_list_media.description: Lists the files in a brand's Nuelink media library, newest first.
actions.nuelink_list_media.props.brandId: The numeric brand ID from nuelink_list_brands.
actions.nuelink_list_media.props.page.de: Which page of results to return, starting at 1. When the output says hasMore is true, run again with the next page number.
actions.nuelink_list_media.props.perPage: How many results to return per page (1 to 100).
actions.nuelink_list_media.props.type.de: Only this media category. APPLICATION covers every document record; DOCUMENT only office/document MIME types.
actions.nuelink_list_published_posts.des: Lists what Nuelink sent to each channel, with delivery status, post URL and engagement counts.
actions.nuelink_list_published_posts.pro: The numeric brand ID from nuelink_list_brands.
Only results for this channel (from nuelink_list_channels).

Text contained in the published body (up to 255 characters).
actions.nuelink_move_posts.description: Moves up to 100 posts from one collection to another in the same brand.
actions.nuelink_move_posts.props.brandId: The numeric brand ID from nuelink_list_brands.
actions.nuelink_move_posts.props.destina: A different collection of the same brand.
actions.nuelink_move_posts.props.sourceC: The collection that currently holds every listed post.
actions.nuelink_remove_collection_channe: Disconnects a channel from a collection. The channel stays connected to the brand.
The numeric brand ID from nuelink_list_brands.
The numeric channel ID, from the collection's channels in nuelink_list_collections.
The numeric collection ID from nuelink_list_collections.
actions.nuelink_update_automation_status: Pauses a feed automation, or activates it again.
The numeric automation ID from nuelink_list_automations.
The numeric brand ID from nuelink_list_brands.
actions.nuelink_update_collection.descri: Renames a collection, changes its description or evergreen interval, or pauses or resumes it.
The numeric brand ID from nuelink_list_brands.
Remove the description. Do not combine with New Description.
The numeric collection ID from nuelink_list_collections.
Up to 1,000 characters. Empty keeps the current one.
0 turns evergreen off. Empty keeps it.

1 to 255 characters. Empty keeps the current title.
actions.nuelink_update_post.description: Changes the caption, publish mode, schedule or queue position of a post that is not published yet.
actions.nuelink_update_post.props.brandI: The numeric brand ID from nuelink_list_brands.
actions.nuelink_update_post.props.captio: Replaces the post text (up to 3,000 characters). Leave empty to keep it.
actions.nuelink_update_post.props.postId: The numeric post ID from nuelink_create_post or nuelink_list_brand_posts.
actions.nuelink_update_post.props.publis: Leave empty to keep the current mode.
actions.nuelink_update_post.props.queueP: Move a queued post to the front or back of its queue.
actions.nuelink_update_post.props.schedu: Required with New Publish Mode SCHEDULE, not allowed otherwise. ISO-8601 with an offset, e.g. 2026-10-12T09:00:00+03:00.
actions.nuelink_upload_file.description: Uploads one image, video or PDF to the brand's Nuelink media library and returns its media ID.
actions.nuelink_upload_file.props.brandI: The numeric brand ID from nuelink_list_brands.
actions.nuelink_upload_file.props.file.d: A JPG, PNG, BMP, MP4, MOV or PDF file (URL or file reference), up to 100 MB.
actions.update_post.description: Changes the caption of a post that is not published yet, turns it back into a draft, reschedules it or moves it in the queue.
actions.update_post.props.caption.descri: Replaces the post text (up to 3,000 characters). Leave empty to keep the current caption. Media is not changed.
actions.update_post.props.postId.descrip: The numeric ID of the post, from Create Post in Collection or List Posts.
actions.update_post.props.publishMode.de: Leave empty to keep the current mode.
Move a queued post to the front or back of its collection queue. Works on its own or with New Publish Mode = Add to Queue.
actions.update_post.props.scheduledAt.de: Required when New Publish Mode is Schedule, at least 10 minutes ahead; not allowed otherwise. Include a timezone offset.
actions.upload_media.description: Uploads an image, video or PDF to the brand's Nuelink media library and returns its media ID for Create Post in Collection.
actions.upload_media.props.file.descript: A JPG, PNG, BMP, MP4, MOV or PDF file, up to 100 MB.
description: Social media scheduling: create, schedule, edit and track posts across your Nuelink brands and collections.
triggers.new_published_post.description: Fires when Nuelink publishes a post to a channel (or fails to, if you choose Failed). Runs once per channel.
triggers.new_published_post.props.collec: Only fire for posts from this collection. Leave empty for all collections.
